what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1976?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 1995-2010 reports and FY2011-FY2025. The 1976 annual town report prints no wage list: the whole text (160 pages) was searched for gross wage (no hits), payroll (7 hits: p44 an article's `payroll voucher`, a Treasurer's prose line, the `Payroll Deductions` receipt and payment lines p65, p71) and salary; it prints only salary lines in the voted budget (p45-46, e.g. `Salary, Chairman 1,000.00`) and the accountant's schedule (p79-90), and personnel changes by name with no pay (p127-128) (sources/data/report-tables/1976/). — closes: the Town's calendar-1976 payroll register (W-2 totals by employee) from the Treasurer's office.

what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates in fiscal 1977?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1976 report records the articles amending the Classification and Salary Schedule (p44, p55: `amending the Classification and Salary Schedule voted on April 3, 1976`) and prints one pay scale, the police (p55, landed as `report-pay-schedule`); no grade-by-step schedule. Searched salary schedule, classification, step and grade across the whole text (sources/data/report-tables/1976/). — closes: the Personnel Committee's Classification and Salary Schedule as voted April 3, 1976.

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in fiscal 1976, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1976 report prints the revolving funds' year-end balances only, as lines of the general fund balance sheet (p74 `Revolving Funds: School Lunch 24,630.63, School Athletics 2.89`), the school lunch program's own report (p153) and the School Department's special accounts (p157-158); no town-wide receipts-and-disbursements schedule by fund. Searched special revenue and revolving across the whole text (sources/data/report-tables/1976/). — closes: the Accountant's fiscal-1976 schedule of revolving and special funds.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for fiscal 1977?
why: `report-valuation` holds valuation and tax history from the 2000-2010 reports. The 1976 report prints the total real estate and personal property valuation and the tax rate in a facts list (p3, not landed) and the Assessors' prose on revaluation (p7); no valuation by class and no overlay or new growth schedule. Searched valuation and tax rate across the whole text (sources/data/report-tables/1976/). — closes: the Assessors' fiscal-1977 recapitulation (LA-4) and tax rate computation.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1976, and what did sealing bring in by device?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and fees from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1976 report prints the Inspector of Weights and Measures as a budget line (p45, p69, p83), a receipt line `Sealing Fees 215.00` (p67) and one mention at p34; no Sealer's report. Searched sealer, sealing and weights and measures across the whole text (sources/data/report-tables/1976/). — closes: the Inspector of Weights and Measures' 1976 annual report to the Selectmen.
